description: Looking for group (lfg, mostly realm channel) and life inside a hunting group (group_hunt).

lines.text: {class}, level {level}, looking for a group. Happy to travel.
Level {level} healer free for a group. I keep folks standing.
Level {level} {class} with a shield and a steady taunt, looking for a group.
Try asking around {zone}. A few groups were forming there earlier.
Our group is settled on {target}. Steady pulls, decent experience.
Keep the puller topped up and you will be fine.
Speed and resists are up. Pull when ready.
Any groups out there need a {class}? Level {level}, ready now.
Solo is getting slow. Anyone have a spot for a level {level} {class}?
Hoping for a steady group around level {level}. Not picky about the camp.
Is anyone hunting near {zone}? Could use a group.
Any room in a group for one more? I am level {level}.
Tired of fighting alone out here. Group, anyone?
Seeking a group for the evening. I bring patience and good manners.
{class} looking to group. I know my role and I listen to the leader.
LFG, level {level}. Will go wherever the experience is.
Does anyone have a group with room? Happy to fill any gap.
One {class} seeking company for a few hours of hunting.
Lone {class} at level {level} wants a group. Any takers?
If a group needs a body, I am free and nearby.
Group up, anyone? I am in {zone} and getting nowhere on my own.
Want to join a group hunting {target}. Level {level} {class}.
Anyone camping {target}? I would gladly join in.
Experience is crawling solo. Any group with a free slot?
Seeking a group, any level near {level}. I will run to you.
Free {class} here, rested and ready. Who needs one?
Spot open anywhere? Level {level}, can be there quickly.
Need a group badly. Even a duo would do.
Small group or full, I am not fussy. Level {level} looking.
Who is out hunting tonight? I would like to tag along.
My last group broke up. Anyone forming a new one?
Group just disbanded on me. Level {level} {class} free again.
Not in a rush, just want company and some steady pulls.
Willing to travel for a good group. Level {level}, {class}.
Duo partner wanted around level {level}. Anyone?
If someone starts a group, count me in.
Anyone want to start a group? I can lead if nobody else will.
Happy to start a group if a few of you are free. Level {level} here.
Forming a small group near {zone}. Need a healer and anyone else who is awake.
Short on time but would love one good hunt. Any groups?
Grinding alone is lonely work. Group, anyone?
Ready to hunt and not picky. Just need a few friendly faces.
Fair on loot, slow to anger, quick to assist. Lfg.
Guild is all asleep, so I am asking the realm. Any group with room?
{guild} folk are busy elsewhere. Anyone else need a {class}?
Packed my bags, mended my armor, and now I just need a group.
Would anyone take a {class} who talks too much but heals the mood?
Any {realm} groups near {zone} with room for one?
Third time asking, still hopeful. Group for a level {level}?
Healer free. I will keep you on your feet if you keep them off me.
Level {level} {class} looking for a group. Heals, rez, the usual.
Healer free. Bring a tank and I bring the mending.
Any group short a healer? I can be there soon.
{class} wants a group that does not pull three at once.
Groups without a healer, I am your answer. Level {level}.
Healer here, fully rested and patient. Who needs me?
Done soloing at a crawl. Healer looking for a real group.
Mending hands for hire, paid in good company and fair loot.
Tank lfg. I hold the line, you do the rest.
Shield arm is free. Level {level} {class} looking for a group.
Any group need someone to stand in front? That is my whole job.
Tank free near {zone}. Need a healer or a group with one.
Heavy armor, short temper with adds. {class} looking for a group.
I can take a beating all day if someone is healing. Group?
Caster seeking a group. I hit hard but fold fast, so a tank would be lovely.
Level {level} {class} free. Plenty of damage, very little armor.
Nuker looking for a group. I promise not to pull aggro. Much.
Caster here, after a group with someone sturdy up front.
Any room for a caster? I bring big damage and a short power bar.
I will keep the damage coming and stay at the back. Group anyone?
Support class seeking a group. Buffs, crowd control, the boring bits that win fights.
Level {level} {class} looking for a group. Mez and buffs on offer.
Want speed on your runs? Level {level} {class} looking for a group.
Crowd control available. Any group pulling big?
I keep adds asleep and spirits high. {class} wants a group.
Pet class looking for a group. Two of us for the price of one slot.
Me and my pet are both looking for a group. Level {level}.
Pet tanking works, but a real group is better. Anyone?
Stealther seeking a group. I can scout pulls and stay quiet.
Level {level} {class} free. I hit hard from behind if someone holds aggro.
Even a sneak gets lonely. Room for a stealther anywhere?
Archer free. I can pull from a long way off.
Level {level} {class} looking for a group. Good puller, full quiver.
Need a puller? Bow strung, arrows fletched, ready to go.
Damage dealer free. Point me at it and stand back.
Level {level} {class} looking for a group that pulls quick.
Melee seeking group. I hit things and I do not complain about loot.
New to all this. Any group for a low level willing to learn?
Still finding my feet. Anyone hunting near the starter towns?
Low level looking for company. Not much gear but plenty of spirit.
Teens group wanted. Level {level}, eager and quick to learn.
These mobs hit harder than they used to. Group for a level {level}?
Twenties group anyone? Solo stopped working a few levels back.
Level {level} needs a group. The experience bar barely moves now.
Thirties group wanted. Gear sorted, potions packed.
The forties grind is real. Level {level} {class} wants a group.
Any group heading to Darkness Falls? Level {level} {class} free.
High level {class} after something worthwhile to hunt. Group?
Close to fifty and need a group to push the last stretch.
Darkness Falls group forming anywhere? I have the time if you have room.
Not quite ready for the frontier yet. Group for some monster hunting?
Group forming for Tepok's Mine? I can be at the entrance soon.
Any group hunting in Keltoi Fogou? Level {level} looking.
Looking for company in Lyonesse. The undead out here are no joke solo.
Wanted, one Salisbury Plains group. Anything but the giants.
Anyone heading to the Stonehenge Barrows? Need a group.
Group in Avalon Marsh with room? I am tired of the bog.
Anyone running Caer Sidi? Level {level} {class} would love a spot.
Krondon group anyone? Heard it is worth the trip.
Seeking a group in Spindelhalla. Level {level}, ready to go.
Any group out in Malmohus? I could use the company in the cold.
Kobolds are thick in Vendo Caverns. Any group with room?
Anyone heading to Trollheim? Need a group, not afraid of trolls.
Group needed in Raumarik. Level {level} {class}, can travel.
Tuscaren Glacier group forming anywhere? Count me in.
Hoping for a Nisse's Lair group, if anyone is still down there.
Group in Muire Tomb anyone? Level {level} looking.
The Cursed Forest earns its name solo. Group, please?
Anyone hunting the Valley of Bri Leith? Could use a group.
Koalinth Caverns group anyone? Level {level} {class}, ready now.
Seeking a group out in the Sheeroe Hills. Those fomorians hit hard.
Galladoria group forming anywhere? Level {level} and keen.
Spraggon Den group wanted. Low level, but I learn quick.
Saw a group near {zone} a little while ago. Might be worth a look.
Most groups I have seen are out past {zone} today.
Sorry, ours is full. Try around {zone}.
Same here, been looking for a while.
Keep at it, someone always needs one more.
Ours just filled up, sorry. Good luck out there.
Check the camps in {zone}. Folks were forming earlier.
If you find one, ask if they need two.
Wish I could help, my group has no room.
Ask again in a little while. Groups break up all the time.
I am looking too. Maybe we start our own?
Duo with me until something bigger turns up?
No luck here either. Quiet day for groups.
A group was asking for one more near {zone}. Worth a run.
Healers always find groups faster than the rest of us. Good luck.
There is usually a crowd around {zone}.
Heard a group in {zone} lost their healer. Might be your chance.
{guild} has folks out near {zone}. Ask around.
Same boat. Solo is slow going right now.
Someone was shouting for a tank a moment ago.
Plenty of groups around {zone} if you can get there.
Hang in there, the evening crowd will turn up soon.
Not me, sorry. Try a few camps over.
Nothing on my end. Might be worth soloing a bit until one forms.
Good level for groups. Should not take long.
Groups at that level are thin right now. Patience.
Try {zone}. That is where most of the action was.
Ask the folks hunting {target}. They looked short a few.
Count me in too if anyone answers.
Nobody near me is grouping. Odd and quiet today.
Heh, I have been asking for ages. Good luck.
Seems like everyone is out at the frontier tonight.
Groups were full near {zone} last I looked, but worth a try.
Not grouped either. Maybe a few of us can team up.
Ours is on slow pulls. You might want somewhere busier.
Try near Ludlow. Groups often head out from there.
Folks were gathering at Audliten earlier. Worth a look.
There was a crowd outside Mag Mell a while back.
A tank would solve all our problems right now. Anyone?
You and me both. Patience pays, usually.
Pulling now, get ready.
Two coming in. Watch the second one.
Next pull in a moment. Healer, you good?
Bringing one back. Mind the runner.
Inc! Bigger than it looked.
That pull had friends. Sorry, everyone.
Hold until my call, I will pull.
Pull is on its way. Nobody hit it until the tank has it.
Arrow away, it is coming.
One at a time from now on. Last pull was too lively.
We have a nice rhythm on {target} now.
Holding the camp on {target}. Experience is flowing.
This camp is perfect. Nobody else is even near us.
Steady pulls, steady heals. This is how it should be.
Healing up, give me a moment before the next one.
Low on power, slow the pulls a little.
Rez going up, stay where you are.
Everyone topped off. Pull when ready.
Tank, watch your health. I can only heal so fast.
Healer is oom. Sit for a bit, please.
Group heal coming, bunch up.
Stay in range, please. I cannot heal you from over there.
Buffs are fading. Hold the pull while I refresh them.
Rebuffing now. Nobody pull for a moment.
Speed is up. On to the next camp.
Mezzing the add. Do not touch the sleeping one.
Add is mezzed. Kill the first one and leave that alone.
I have aggro. Everyone on mine.
Taunting the adds off the healer. Stay close.
Shield up. Bring the next one.
Lost one off me, it is on the caster.
Nuking the runner. Someone slow it down.
Out of power. Sitting for a bit.
Uh oh, I may have pulled aggro with that last one.
Waiting for the tank to build aggro before I cast.
Pet is tanking the add. Kill the first one fast.
My pet is on the left one. Help it out.
Scouted ahead. Three more past the bend, all alone.
Coming in from behind on yours. Keep it facing you.
On the add. Keep the big one busy.
Hitting hard, keep the heals on the tank.
Quick rest break, everyone. Sit and get your power back.
Taking a breather. Nobody wander off.
Pausing for power. Good time to sort your bags.
Short break. Whoever wanders off pulls the next one.
Sitting for power. That fight emptied me.
Something dropped. Roll for it if you can use it.
Loot is on the corpse, roll if you want it.
Nice drop there. Who can use it?
Rolling on that if nobody needs it more.
Let the healer have first pick. They earned it.
Vendor trash again. At least it pays for repairs.
Need before greed, everyone. Keep it fair.
Lovely pulls. Whoever is pulling, keep it up.
Great pull. Clean, single, no adds.
Our puller has not brought back a single add all evening.
Best group I have had in weeks.
Thank you, healer. Good heals tonight.
That was a close one. Well held, everyone.
Fine work, group. Bars are moving.
Experience is pouring in. Let us keep this going.
Not one death so far. We are doing something right.
Train coming through! Everyone back to the wall.
Who pulled that? Never mind, just kill it.
Wipe coming, run for the zone line!
Somebody aggroed the whole camp. Run!
We lost the healer. Fall back and regroup.
Tank down! Kite it until the rez comes.
Add on the left, add on the left!
Runner! Do not let it bring friends.
I need to head off soon. One or two more pulls.
Last pull for me, then I head back to town.
Almost out of potions. Might need a town run soon.
Bags are full. Somebody remind me to sell later.
This camp in {zone} is better than I hoped.
Good spot here in {zone}. Shame we had to wait for it.
{guild} groups always seem to find the best camps.
Darkness Falls is crowded, but this group handles it well.
First real group for me. This is so much faster.
These camps hit hard. Nobody get careless.
Full group on a quiet night in Lyonesse. Hard to beat.
Fine work, comrades. Camelot would be proud.
Skal! Another one down for Midgard.
By Odin's beard, that pull was enormous.
Another one down. Hibernia would be proud of us tonight.
By Lugh, that was close. Rest a moment.
Same here, almost out of power.
Watch the adds.
On my way back to the group.
Nice and steady, agreed.
Ready when you are.
Give me a moment to sit.
Good call.
Pass on that one, go ahead.
Healer here, everyone looks fine.
Got it. Holding back until the tank has it.
Ha, that was close.
Nice one.
Same, this camp is great.
Careful, my health is low.
Waiting on power, then go.
Cover my back on the next one.
I can grab the add.
Agreed. One at a time is plenty.
Heh, nobody saw that.
Fine by me.
Mez is ready if we need it.
Buffs still have time on them.
Power is full. Go when ready.
Health is fine on my side.
Right behind you on the next pull.
Well pulled, puller.
Thanks for the heals.
Keep it coming, I am having fun.
Sounds good to me.
Yep, give it a second.
Staying on the add until it drops.
My pet is ready.
Sitting until I am full again.
Do not mind me, just catching my breath.
That one hurt, no question.
Someone else take it, I am fine.
Tank is solid, no worries.
Better than soloing, that is for sure.
Looks good from back here.
Careful, a wanderer is coming our way.
Easy does it. No need to rush.
Mine is down, switching to yours.
